issues.summary: BacktestEngine (1305 lines) and StandardBacktestEngine (928 lines) are large files
evidence: engine.py contains 1305 lines with BacktestEngine class handling trade execution, compliance integration, learning engine updates, and signal processing
StandardBacktestEngine extends base with additional methods for buy/sell execution with compliance
Files are large but responsibilities are decomposed into services (PositionManager, TradeExecutor, etc.)
issues.suggestion: Consider if file size is acceptable given domain complexity (file contains legitimately complex trading logic with proper service decomposition) vs extracting additional helper classes for compliance flow orchestration

issues.summary: Singleton factory functions duplicated across modules with identical pattern
evidence: di_container.py has get_portfolio_service(), get_signal_scorer_service(), get_strategy_registry() etc with identical singleton pattern
models.py has get_glosten_milgrom_model(), get_kyle_model(), get_roll_estimator() etc
All follow: global _instance; if None: create; return instance pattern
issues.suggestion: The pattern is consistent, which is good. Consider if this is acceptable repetition (pattern is clear and works) or if a generic singleton decorator/factory would reduce boilerplate without adding complexity

issues.summary: BacktestEngine constructor has 8 parameters, StandardBacktestEngine has 9
evidence: BacktestEngine.__init__ takes: config, diagnostic_logger, strategy, enable_risk_envelope, compliance_engine, strategy_name, total_portfolio_capital, reallocation_engine
StandardBacktestEngine.__init__ has same parameters plus inheritance from base
Parameters are related (all configure backtest behavior) but count is high
issues.suggestion: Parameters are genuinely related to backtest configuration and each has independent meaning. Grouping would obscure intent (e.g., a BacktestOptions bag would add indirection without semantic benefit). Consider acceptable as-is.

root_causes: Large engine files reflect genuine domain complexity in trading system backtesting rather than poor decomposition
Singleton pattern repetition is a tradeoff between DRY and explicit clarity
likely_symptoms: File size signals in mechanical analysis may over-flag files where size reflects complexity not poor design
possible_false_positives: engine.py flagged as design_concern due to file size but actually has good service decomposition
Parameter counts may be appropriate for the domain legitimate configuration needs
